candidate.title: CAGE-Seq
candidate.scope: The assigned Illumina CAGE-Seq schematic: random N15/EcoP15I-primed reverse transcription, RNA biotinylation, RNase-dependent cap trapping, cDNA recovery, and a compressed linker/EcoP15I tag-generation block ending at cDNA. CAGE and cap-analysis gene expression name this target; cap trapping is an embedded selection component. The depicted implementation is clarified by the full-text Takahashi et al. optimized Illumina CAGE protocol (PMID 22362160). The upper and lower molecules contrast incomplete and cap-reaching cDNA outcomes within one workflow. They are neither alternative named methods nor evidence for independent sample splitting or pooling. The left RNA/Cap icon is explanatory context, not a transcription operation. Unshown CAGE adaptations and later library-completion steps are outside this extraction.
